findings.explanation: Both INV-1005 and REC-1005 explicitly reference PO-1005, but no purchase order document was supplied for this transaction at all, leaving the authorization of the 59,000 INR spend unverified.
Receipt REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before invoice INV-1005 (2026-07-21), an out-of-sequence ordering that is plausible for a goods-receipt note but warrants verification.
